original.target_description: Study 2; 240 German 10th graders in 13 classes from four secondary schools; timing × form of instruction interaction on immediate-posttest conceptual knowledge, two-factor ANCOVA with pretest and math score as covariates.

n.sample_role: Students in the final Study 2 sample and immediate-posttest analysis; Table 8 reports all four condition Ns.
n.exclusions: No immediate-posttest exclusions reported. Six students absent at pretesting had pretest and math-score missing values imputed with overall means.
n.location: Printed p. 80 (PDF p. 7), §7.1 and Table 7; printed p. 81 (PDF p. 8), Table 8 and §8.2.
n.quote: Participants were 240 10th graders (13 classes) recruited from four secondary schools in Germany.

es.location: Printed p. 81 (PDF p. 8), §8.2 Learning outcomes immediate posttest, conceptual-knowledge ANCOVA paragraph.
es.quote: We further found a signiﬁcant interaction (F [1,234] ¼ 4.68, p ¼ .03, h2p ¼ .02)

p.location: Printed p. 81 (PDF p. 8), §8.2 Learning outcomes immediate posttest, conceptual-knowledge ANCOVA paragraph.
p.quote: We further found a signiﬁcant interaction (F [1,234] ¼ 4.68, p ¼ .03, h2p ¼ .02)

notes: Fresh original-only validation using the named published article; title and DOI match the assigned reference. Requested etasq is printed as partial eta squared; no conversion. The locator PDF p. 8 identifies the immediate-posttest ANCOVA, not the separate multilevel interaction on printed p. 82. Table 7 identifies the final sample as N=240; Table 8 supplies immediate-posttest condition Ns 51, 56, 62, 71. Unassigned replication and reported_success are placeholders, not acquisition failures. Quotes preserve the frozen text mathematical glyphs, with line breaks joined.
